ayahs.arabicText: هَلْ اَتٰى عَلَى الْاِنْسَانِ حِیْنٌ مِّنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ یَكُنْ شَیْئًا مَّذْكُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: Was there a period of time when man was not even worthy of a mention?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ اَمْشَاجٍ١ۖۗ نَّبْتَلِیْهِ فَجَعَلْنٰهُ سَمِیْعًۢا بَصِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Verily We created man out of a drop of intermingled sperm so that We might try him, and We therefore endowed him with hearing and sight.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا هَدَیْنٰهُ السَّبِیْلَ اِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَّ اِمَّا كَفُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: Surely We showed him the Right Path, regardless of whether he chooses to be thankful or unthankful (to his Lord).

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّاۤ اَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكٰفِرِیْنَ سَلٰسِلَاۡ وَ اَغْلٰلًا وَّ سَعِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: For the unbelievers, We have kept ready chains and fetters and a Blazing Fire.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الْاَبْرَارَ یَشْرَبُوْنَ مِنْ كَاْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُوْرًاۚ
ayahs.translation: The virtuous shall drink from a cup tempered with camphor water.

ayahs.arabicText: عَیْنًا یَّشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللّٰهِ یُفَجِّرُوْنَهَا تَفْجِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: This will be a gushing spring wherefrom Allah's servants shall drink wine, a spring from which they will take out channels wherever they wish.

ayahs.arabicText: یُوْفُوْنَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَ یَخَافُوْنَ یَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهٗ مُسْتَطِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: These will be the ones who fulfil their vows and dread the Day whose woe shall be spread far and wide;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یُطْعِمُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ عَلٰى حُبِّهٖ مِسْكِیْنًا وَّ یَتِیْمًا وَّ اَسِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: those who, for the love of Him, feed the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللّٰهِ لَا نُرِیْدُ مِنْكُمْ جَزَآءً وَّ لَا شُكُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: (saying): “We feed you only for Allah's sake; we do not seek of you any recompense or thanks,

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا نَخَافُ مِنْ رَّبِّنَا یَوْمًا عَبُوْسًا قَمْطَرِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: we fear from our Lord a Day that shall be long and distressful.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَوَقٰىهُمُ اللّٰهُ شَرَّ ذٰلِكَ الْیَوْمِ وَ لَقّٰىهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَّ سُرُوْرًاۚ
ayahs.translation: So Allah shall guard them against the woe of that Day, and will procure them freshness and joy,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَزٰىهُمْ بِمَا صَبَرُوْا جَنَّةً وَّ حَرِیْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and will reward them for their steadfastness with Paradise and robes of silk.

ayahs.arabicText: مُّتَّكِئِیْنَ فِیْهَا عَلَى الْاَرَآئِكِ١ۚ لَا یَرَوْنَ فِیْهَا شَمْسًا وَّ لَا زَمْهَرِیْرًاۚ
ayahs.translation: There they will recline on elevated couches and will be subjected neither to the burning heat of the sun nor to bitter cold.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ دَانِیَةً عَلَیْهِمْ ظِلٰلُهَا وَ ذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوْفُهَا تَذْلِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: The shades of Paradise will bend over them, and its fruits will be brought within their easy reach;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یُطَافُ عَلَیْهِمْ بِاٰنِیَةٍ مِّنْ فِضَّةٍ وَّ اَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَؔوَارِیْرَاۡۙ
ayahs.translation: and there shall be passed around them vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,

ayahs.arabicText: قَؔوَارِیْرَاۡ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوْهَا تَقْدِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: goblets bright as crystal but made of silver, filled to exact measure.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یُسْقَوْنَ فِیْهَا كَاْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنْجَبِیْلًاۚ
ayahs.translation: Therein they shall be served a cup flavoured with ginger,

ayahs.arabicText: عَیْنًا فِیْهَا تُسَمّٰى سَلْسَبِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: drawn from a spring (in Paradise) called Salsabil.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَطُوْفُ عَلَیْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُوْنَ١ۚ اِذَا رَاَیْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنْثُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: There boys of everlasting youth shall go about attending them: when you see them, you would think that they are scattered pearls.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا رَاَیْتَ ثَمَّ رَاَیْتَ نَعِیْمًا وَّ مُلْكًا كَبِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Whitherto you look around, you will see an abundance of bliss and the glories of a great kingdom.

ayahs.arabicText: عٰلِیَهُمْ ثِیَابُ سُنْدُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَّ اِسْتَبْرَقٌ١٘ وَّ حُلُّوْۤا اَسَاوِرَ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ١ۚ وَ سَقٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: They [i.e., the virtuous] shall be attired in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade and will be adorned with bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them a pure wine to drink.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ هٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَّ كَانَ سَعْیُكُمْ مَّشْكُوْرًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Behold, this is your recompense and your endeavour has been appreciated.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَیْكَ الْقُرْاٰنَ تَنْزِیْلًاۚ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), indeed We have revealed the Qur'an to you in portions.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَ لَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ اٰثِمًا اَوْ كَفُوْرًاۚ
ayahs.translation: So persevere with the command of your Lord and do not pay any heed to the wicked and the unbelieving,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَّ اَصِیْلًاۖۚ
ayahs.translation: and remember the name of your Lord, morning and evening;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنَ الَّیْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهٗ وَ سَبِّحْهُ لَیْلًا طَوِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: and prostrate yourself before Him at night, and extol His Glory during the long watches of the night.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ یُحِبُّوْنَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَ یَذَرُوْنَ وَرَآءَهُمْ یَوْمًا ثَقِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: Verily they love (the good of this world) that is hastily obtainable and are oblivious of the burdensome Day ahead of them.

ayahs.arabicText: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنٰهُمْ وَ شَدَدْنَاۤ اَسْرَهُمْ١ۚ وَ اِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَاۤ اَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: We created them and strengthened their joints; and whenever We wish, We can change their faces entirely.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذْكِرَةٌ١ۚ فَمَنْ شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰى رَبِّهٖ سَبِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: Verily this is an Exhortation; so let him who so will take a way to his Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا تَشَآءُوْنَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ یَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِیْمًا حَكِیْمًاۗۖ
ayahs.translation: But your willing shall be of no avail until Allah Himself so wills. Surely Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise.

ayahs.arabicText: یُّدْخِلُ مَنْ یَّشَآءُ فِیْ رَحْمَتِهٖ١ؕ وَ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ اَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا اَلِیْمًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: He admits to His Mercy whomsoever He pleases. As for the wrong-doers, He has prepared for them a grievous chastisement.
